text:
maria: quick ask — need a short throughput/latency sweep for the continuous-batching changes on my PR before tomorrow's rollout. can someone kick a 10m run on staging-west with max_batch_size=64, max_tokens=1024, and collect p95/p99 + KV cache hit rate? not a full canary, just a smoke/throughput check. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321

sasha: I can take this at 10:30am PT. do you want raw perf artifacts or the summarized dashboard?

maria: both please. raw logs + a small CSV of per-second throughput and latency. include cpu/gpu utilization if possible.

kevin: heads-up — the staging-west job usually auto-scales the pool. use `--disable-autoscale` in the run so we get consistent baselines.

piotr: also add `--prefill=0.2` flag to simulate typical traffic shape, we saw weird jitter without it last week.

sasha: noted. command I'll run:```bash
./scripts/run_throughput.sh \n  --env staging-west \n  --duration 600 \n  --max-batch 64 \n  --max-tokens 1024 \n  --disable-autoscale \n  --prefill 0.2 \n  --output ./artifacts/cb-sweep-1769456789````

jen: FYI if the run exceeds GPU memory we should fall back to the quantized variant (q4f16). add a quick check to abort and mark as OOM in the metadata.

maria: agreed — please capture OOMs as separate field. also tag the run with `cb-pr-4321` and `smoke` so the dashboard filters them.

deploy-bot: started job ci/throughput/1769456789 (runner: staging-west-03). logs: https://ci.redwood/throughput/1769456789

sasha: job started. I'll post the compressed logs and a short summary when done. ETA ~12 minutes after start. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: awesome, thanks! if anything flakey shows up ping me and we'll triage.

kevin: small note — when you upload artifacts include `run-config.json` with the exact flags so we can repro.

piotr: and please run the same with `--max-batch 32` (cheap compare) if time permits. helps isolate scaling knee.

sasha: will do 64 then 32 back-to-back if runner is free.

maria: perfect. linking this thread in the PR for traceability. :white_check_mark:
